reply.text:
Whether heavy lifting is okay on Accutane is a question for your prescribing doctor or dermatologist. It's a medication question, and I can't clear it or rule it out from the coaching side.

Ask them directly whether there are any limits on heavy loading or intense training while you're on it, and what they'd want you to watch for. Whatever they clear, I'll build your training around it. If they want you to keep things lighter for a stretch, tell me and we'll work out the plan from there.
